specName: Rorca E2E Journey Tests — Navigate, Break, Fix, Continue
title: rorca-e2e-journey
_notes: Persona-based E2E testing using Chrome DevTools MCP. The journey-tester skill drives this spec — agents navigate real browser, fix broken code immediately, commit when working. Run AFTER rorca-convention-agents-rebuild. Skill: .claude/skills/journey-tester.md must be loaded for all stories.
_executionOrder: 4th — after rorca-convention-agents-rebuild. Requires: npm run dev (port 5210) + backend (port 3030) running. Chrome DevTools MCP must be available.

userStories.title: Alex: Hub loads with workspace context and recent runs
userStories.description: Persona: Alex (Developer). Navigate to http://localhost:5210. Confirm: (1) Page is not blank. (2) Sidebar is present with 'New Spec' button visible. (3) Hub shows at least one section (Recent Runs, Pending Specs, Ready to Run, or Add Workspace). (4) No console errors of type 'error'. (5) No network 4xx/5xx on initial API calls (/api/workspaces, /api/pipeline/runs). If any section is blank when data should exist, read the HubPanel component and fix the issue. Take snapshot before and after.
acceptanceCriteria: Hub renders without blank sections or React crashes
Sidebar New Spec button visible
At least one hub section (runs, specs, or workspace prompt) renders
Zero console errors of severity 'error' on load
No 4xx/5xx network errors on /api/workspaces or /api/pipeline/runs

userStories.title: Jordan: Review Queue shows correct pending spec count with badge
userStories.description: Persona: Jordan (PM). Navigate to /queue. Confirm: (1) Queue panel renders with heading and list. (2) If specs are pending: each card shows spec name, story count, date. (3) If empty: empty state message shown (not a blank div). (4) The queue badge in the sidebar matches the count of items shown in the panel. (5) No console errors. If the badge count doesn't match the list count, read ReviewQueuePanel and the sidebar badge logic and fix the mismatch.
acceptanceCriteria: Queue panel renders with list or empty state — never blank
Sidebar queue badge count matches actual pending spec count
Each spec card shows name, story count, and date
No console errors on /queue
No 4xx/5xx on /api/specs?status=pending

userStories.title: Alex: Forge panel — type brief, see token count update, Generate button enabled
userStories.description: Persona: Alex (Developer). Navigate to /forge. (1) Confirm textarea is visible and focusable. (2) Type a 50-word brief about building a feature. (3) Confirm token/char count updates (not stuck at 0). (4) Confirm Generate Spec button becomes active (not disabled or greyed out). (5) Confirm model selection shows a valid model (not empty). (6) No console errors. If the Generate button stays disabled after typing, read SpecForgePanelPage to find the disabled condition and fix it.
acceptanceCriteria: Textarea accepts input without errors
Token/char counter updates after typing
Generate Spec button is enabled after typing a non-empty brief
Model dropdown shows at least one option
No console errors on /forge

userStories.title: Sam: Direction Stack — L1 content loads and saves
userStories.description: Persona: Sam (SRE). Navigate to /direction (or /settings/direction). (1) Confirm L1 Global textarea loads with existing content (or empty but visible). (2) Confirm L2 Domain and L3 Project textareas are visible. (3) Type a change in L1. (4) Confirm save indicator appears (Unsaved → Saving → Saved). (5) Reload page. (6) Confirm the typed change persists. If save doesn't persist, read the direction stack route and frontend save logic and fix the PUT /api/direction call.
acceptanceCriteria: All 3 direction layer textareas (L1/L2/L3) are visible
L1 content loads from API without blank render
Save indicator cycles through Unsaved → Saving → Saved
Change persists after page reload
No console errors, no 4xx/5xx on PUT /api/direction

userStories.title: Alex: Pipeline Monitor — select a past run and see story list
userStories.description: Persona: Alex (Developer). Navigate to /pipeline. (1) Confirm the panel renders with run picker or run list. (2) If past runs exist: select one. (3) Confirm the Stories tab populates with story cards (not stuck at 0/N pending). (4) Confirm each story card shows status (pass/fail/skip) and story ID. (5) Confirm Terminal tab shows raw log content (not blank). (6) No console errors. If Stories tab shows wrong count or all-pending despite a finished run, read PipelineMonitorPanel and fix the spec JSON polling or SSE seed logic.
acceptanceCriteria: Pipeline panel renders with run picker
Selecting a past run populates Stories tab with real statuses
Story cards show ID, title, and status
Terminal tab shows log content for the selected run
No console errors, no 4xx on /api/pipeline/runs/:id

userStories.title: Jordan: Marketplace — Templates tab works, Packs tab present
userStories.description: Persona: Jordan (PM). Navigate to /marketplace. (1) Confirm Templates tab renders template cards or empty state. (2) Click a template card — confirm detail view or modal opens. (3) Confirm Packs tab exists (added by REB-005). (4) Click Packs tab — confirm it renders without crash and shows empty state or installed packs. (5) No console errors. If Packs tab is missing, read TemplateMarketplacePanel and wire it. If clicking a template card causes a crash, fix the crash.
acceptanceCriteria: Templates tab shows cards or empty state — not blank
Clicking a template card opens detail without crash
Packs tab is present in the tab switcher
Packs tab renders without crash (empty state acceptable)
No console errors on /marketplace

userStories.title: Sam: Workspace Settings — all tabs load, Agents tab has Personas section
userStories.description: Persona: Sam (SRE). Navigate to /workspace-settings. (1) Confirm all tabs are visible: General, Direction, Context, GitHub, Env Vars, Pipeline, Hooks, Agents. (2) Click each tab and confirm no crash. (3) On the Agents tab: confirm Personas subsection is present (added by REB-006). (4) If no personas installed: confirm empty state message shown. (5) No console errors on any tab. If a tab causes a crash, read WorkspaceSettingsPanel and fix it.
acceptanceCriteria: All workspace settings tabs render without crash
Agents tab has Personas subsection
Personas subsection shows persona cards or empty state
Clicking between tabs does not crash the panel
No console errors on /workspace-settings

userStories.title: Sam: Health Dashboard — score visible, Drift section present
userStories.description: Persona: Sam (SRE). Navigate to /health. (1) Confirm health score is displayed (a number 0–100). (2) Confirm health components list is visible with at least one component. (3) Confirm Convention Drift section is present (added by REB-007). (4) Click 'Run Drift Check' button. (5) Confirm response renders — either drift items or 'No drift detected'. (6) No console errors. If drift check button is missing, read HealthDashboardPanel and wire REB-007.
acceptanceCriteria: Health score number is displayed
Health components list visible
Convention Drift section present with Run Drift Check button
Clicking Run Drift Check calls POST /api/workspaces/:id/conventions/drift
Drift results rendered without crash
No console errors on /health

userStories.title: Alex: Settings — all 6 tabs load without crash
userStories.description: Persona: Alex (Developer). Navigate to /settings. (1) Confirm all 6 tabs visible: Direction, Providers, GitHub, Shortcuts, Account, Billing. (2) Click each tab in sequence. (3) Confirm each renders content or an empty state — never a blank white panel. (4) Providers tab: confirm at least one provider card shows status. (5) Shortcuts tab: confirm keyboard shortcut list is shown. (6) No console errors on any tab.
acceptanceCriteria: All 6 settings tabs (Direction, Providers, GitHub, Shortcuts, Account, Billing) render
No tab causes a blank panel or React crash
Providers tab shows provider status cards
Shortcuts tab shows keyboard shortcut bindings
No console errors on /settings

userStories.title: Sam: Memory Ledger — entries visible, add entry works
userStories.description: Persona: Sam (SRE). Navigate to /memory. (1) Confirm Memory Ledger panel renders. (2) If entries exist: confirm they show category badge, date, and rule text. (3) If empty: confirm empty state shown (not blank). (4) Click 'Add Entry' button (or equivalent). (5) Confirm modal/form opens. (6) Fill in: Category=Architecture, Title='Test entry', Rule='Always use TypeScript strict mode'. (7) Submit. (8) Confirm entry appears in the list. (9) No console errors. If Add Entry causes a crash, fix it.
acceptanceCriteria: Memory Ledger renders with entries or empty state
Add Entry button present and clickable
Add Entry modal opens without crash
Submitting a new entry adds it to the list
New entry shows correct category, title, and rule
No console errors on /memory

userStories.title: Alex: MCP HTTP endpoint responds
userStories.description: Persona: Alex (Developer). Using curl or fetch from browser console: (1) GET http://localhost:3030/mcp — confirm 200 response with transport info (added by REB-009). (2) Check backend/src/server.ts to confirm /mcp route is mounted. (3) If /mcp returns 404: read backend/src/mcp/http-transport.ts and fix the mount in server.ts. Restart backend after fix. (4) Confirm the existing stdio MCP server still works (npx tsx backend/src/mcp/server.ts --help should not crash).
acceptanceCriteria: GET http://localhost:3030/mcp returns 200
Response body contains transport: 'streamable-http'
Existing stdio MCP server unchanged
npx tsc --noEmit passes in backend/

userStories.title: Jordan: Archive — search works, spec detail opens
userStories.description: Persona: Jordan (PM). Navigate to /archive. (1) Confirm archive panel renders with list or empty state. (2) If specs exist in archive: type a search term in the search box. (3) Confirm results filter in real-time or on submit. (4) Click a spec card. (5) Confirm spec detail view opens (slide-over or inline). (6) Confirm story list is visible in the detail view. (7) No console errors. If clicking a spec card causes a crash, fix it.
acceptanceCriteria: Archive panel renders with list or empty state
Search box filters results
Clicking spec card opens detail view without crash
Detail view shows spec name, story count, and story list
No console errors on /archive

userStories.title: Sam: Analytics panels — all load with data or empty state, none blank
userStories.description: Persona: Sam (SRE). Visit each analytics panel: /usage, /costs, /velocity, /activity, /audit-log. For each: (1) Confirm panel renders with a chart, table, or explicit empty state. (2) Confirm no panel renders a completely blank white page. (3) Confirm no console errors. If any panel renders blank, read the component and fix: usually a missing null check on data or a failed API call. Fix each blank panel before moving to the next.
acceptanceCriteria: /usage renders token usage chart or empty state
/costs renders cost breakdown or empty state
/velocity renders velocity chart or empty state
/activity renders activity feed or empty state
/audit-log renders audit events or empty state
No blank white panels anywhere in analytics
No console errors on any analytics route

userStories.title: Alex: Forge multiPass toggle generates spec with 6-pass progress
userStories.description: Persona: Alex (Developer). Navigate to /forge. (1) Open Advanced Options. (2) Find the multiPass toggle (added by REB-008). (3) Enable multiPass. (4) Type a brief: 'Add user authentication with email/password, JWT tokens, and password reset flow'. (5) Click Generate Spec. (6) Confirm 6-pass progress steps appear: PM Analysis, Spec Writer, UX Designer, Best Practices, Adversarial Review, Verifier. (7) Wait for completion. (8) Confirm spec preview shows a more detailed spec than single-pass would produce. (9) No console errors. If multiPass toggle is missing, read SpecForgePanelPage and wire REB-008.
acceptanceCriteria: Advanced Options contains multiPass toggle
Enabling multiPass shows 6 named pass steps during generation
Each pass step shows pending/running/completed status
Generation completes with a spec that has stories
No console errors during generation

userStories.title: Final: npx playwright test — all tests pass
userStories.description: Run `npx playwright test` from the Rorca root directory. All 24+ tests in e2e/rorca.spec.ts must pass. If any test fails, read the failure message, navigate to the failing route in Chrome DevTools, identify the root cause, fix the code, restart backend if needed, and re-run the specific test with `npx playwright test --grep 'test name'`. Do not consider this story done until the full test suite passes with 0 failures. After passing, run `npx tsc --noEmit` from root and `cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit` to confirm no type errors introduced by the journey fixes.
acceptanceCriteria: npx playwright test: 0 failures, all tests pass
npx tsc --noEmit (frontend): 0 errors
cd backend && npx tsc --noEmit: 0 errors
Test run duration under 120s
No test marked as skip or todo
